name: piece-kit
use: Every piece. Stage scaling, playback, Web Audio scheduling, site messaging, export API. Copy in with npm run sync-kit.

name: dots-to-wordmark
use: A multi-colour wordmark that can be split into one shape per letter: shapes drop, bounce, then pop into letters.

name: ring-to-G
use: A logo built from arcs: dots spin into a ring, and dash-length arcs lock into the mark (round-cap compensation included).

name: count-up hero number
use: A big stat that counts up in 0.5s with an underline wipe and a label; approximate values stay approximate (5T+).

name: stamp + shake
use: A badge or stamp slams in with outBack plus a decaying shake on what it lands on. Approval, verified, sold.

name: whip-pan shelf
use: A row of cards whips in with motion blur, then keeps drifting. Catalogues, product ranges.

name: search pull-back
use: One search bar types, then the camera pulls back to a sea of queries that collapse to a point. Scale or crowd moments.

name: pendulum tag
use: A swinging tag with a rotateY flip that resets its content on the back face, so the loop is seamless.

name: radial shape morph
use: Morph any star-shaped forms (circle, rounded square, pill, triangle) point-for-point by sampling radius per angle.
